source_text: On October 8, 2025, the World Health Organization, alongside FIGO, UNFPA, and regional bodies, issued the "Do No Harm" joint statement explicitly condemning medicalization in the Asia-Pacific, asserting that no form of FGM is safe or ethical when performed by health workers, as it violates medical oaths and perpetuates harm without evidence of benefit. [88] [67]
